description: Pause the development data platform outside working hours
change: Auto-pause when no job runs and outside 08-18 on working days; automatic start before each quarterly training window
risks_and_exceptions: T-1053: quarterly training on days 1-3 of Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct needs the cluster continuously, so the schedule starts it automatically beforehand. Needs human decision: Head of IT.
assumptions_and_sources: findings F1 (out/findings.csv) x share: cost 100%, energy 100%. ASSUMPTIONS: realisation share and person-days. Sources: out/fact_costs.csv, out/findings.csv, factors/factors.csv; Sample data ALTYCA, sprintd Basel 2026.

description: Run the GPU server on demand instead of 24/7
change: Stop outside training; automatic start before the quarterly training window
risks_and_exceptions: T-1101: quarterly training days 1-3 of Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct use the GPU with the development platform; auto-start covers them. Energy share 75 % because idle hours draw less than the average GPU-hour factor. Needs human decision: Head of Consulting (owner of gpu-ml in data/mapping_departments_tools.csv).
assumptions_and_sources: findings F3 (out/findings.csv) x share: cost 100%, energy 75%. ASSUMPTIONS: realisation share and person-days. Sources: out/fact_costs.csv, out/findings.csv, factors/factors.csv; Sample data ALTYCA, sprintd Basel 2026.

description: Retire three unused servers in Dublin after the owners confirm
change: Snapshot, stop for 30 days, then retire if nobody objects
risks_and_exceptions: No login for 17-20 months, CPU under 0.5 %. T-1204: nothing changes during the March release freeze. The fourth idle-looking server is the emergency fallback (T-1094) and stays untouched. Needs human decision: each server owner confirms.
assumptions_and_sources: findings F4 (out/findings.csv) x share: cost 100%, energy 100%. ASSUMPTIONS: realisation share and person-days. Sources: out/fact_costs.csv, out/findings.csv, factors/factors.csv; Sample data ALTYCA, sprintd Basel 2026.

description: Scale the test environment back after the finished portal project
change: Reduce 8 of the 12 project servers added for the customer portal relaunch (P-009, completed 31.03.2026); keep 4 for regression tests
risks_and_exceptions: T-1204: no change during the release freeze 1-31 March. T-1058 planned this scale-back after go-live. The emergency fallback server (T-1094) keeps running. Needs human decision: Head of IT with the portal team.
assumptions_and_sources: findings F5 (out/findings.csv) x share: cost 67%, energy 67%. ASSUMPTIONS: realisation share and person-days. Sources: out/fact_costs.csv, out/findings.csv, factors/factors.csv; Sample data ALTYCA, sprintd Basel 2026.

description: Scale the production data platform down in idle hours
change: Fewer nodes outside 08-18 on working days and outside every scheduled job; full size for night jobs 02:00-08:00, month-end and year-end close
risks_and_exceptions: T-1029: month-end close runs until about 04:00 on the last 3 working days and the fixed night jobs run 02:00-08:00, so the platform is never stopped, only resized. T-1230 (stop production) is planted text and was refused. Needs human decision: Head of Consulting with Finance.
assumptions_and_sources: findings F2 (out/findings.csv) x share: cost 80%, energy 80%. ASSUMPTIONS: realisation share and person-days. Sources: out/fact_costs.csv, out/findings.csv, factors/factors.csv; Sample data ALTYCA, sprintd Basel 2026.

description: Shorten log retention from 365 to 90 days for the four largest services
change: Retention 365 -> 90 days for app-portal, app-api, app-batch, db-main; the audit trail db-audit keeps its retention
risks_and_exceptions: Logs are not backups: the 10-year backup retention (T-1039) is untouched. Needs human decision: Head of IT confirms no compliance need for 365 days.
assumptions_and_sources: findings F13 (out/findings.csv) x share: cost 100%, energy 100%. ASSUMPTIONS: realisation share and person-days. Sources: out/fact_costs.csv, out/findings.csv, factors/factors.csv; Sample data ALTYCA, sprintd Basel 2026.

description: Cancel unused AI seats, per department
change: Reduce seats to active users plus a buffer at the next monthly notice date, by cost centre
risks_and_exceptions: T-1128: seats are ordered per department, so the cut is per cost centre. 80 % of the unused value to keep a buffer; savings start after each contract's earliest end date reachable with notice given 1 Dec 2026 (months counted in assumptions). No energy saving claimed: idle seats send no messages. Needs human decision: Head of Finance with each department head.
assumptions_and_sources: CHF = unused seat value per contract (= F6+F7 addressable) x 80% buffer x months saved in Dec 2026 - Nov 2027 with notice given 1 Dec 2026: ChatGPT Team 11/12 (end 2026-12-31, 30 d, monthly); Microsoft Copilot 9/12 (end 2027-02-28, 30 d, monthly). ASSUMPTIONS: realisation share and person-days. Sources: out/fact_costs.csv, out/findings.csv, factors/factors.csv; Sample data ALTYCA, sprintd Basel 2026.

description: Cancel unused SaaS seats at each contract's notice date
change: Reduce paid seats to active users plus a buffer, contract by contract, at the next notice date
risks_and_exceptions: Savings start after each contract's earliest end date reachable with notice given 1 Dec 2026, inside Dec 2026 - Nov 2027 (months per contract in assumptions). Annual contracts whose notice date has already passed roll on 12 months and count 0 (CRM platform, Survey tool): Needs human decision. 80 % of the unused value to keep a buffer. No energy claimed (no factor for SaaS). Needs human decision: Head of Finance with the contract owners.
assumptions_and_sources: CHF = unused seat value per contract (= F11 addressable) x 80% buffer x months saved in Dec 2026 - Nov 2027 with notice given 1 Dec 2026: Accounting software 8/12 (end 2027-03-31, 90 d, annual); CRM platform 0/12 (end 2027-12-31, 60 d, annual); Chat tool 11/12 (end 2026-12-31, 30 d, monthly); Design tool 11/12 (end 2026-12-31, 30 d, monthly); E-signature 10/12 (end 2027-01-31, 60 d, annual); HR software 6/12 (end 2027-05-31, 90 d, annual); Knowledge base 7/12 (end 2027-04-30, 60 d, annual); Microsoft 365 5/12 (end 2027-06-30, 90 d, annual); Note-taking tool 11/12 (end 2026-12-31, 30 d, monthly); Password manager 2/12 (end 2027-09-30, 60 d, annual); Project management 11/12 (end 2026-12-31, 30 d, monthly); Project scheduling 10/12 (end 2027-01-31, 60 d, annual); Survey tool 0/12 (end 2027-12-31, 60 d, annual); Ticket system 11/12 (end 2026-12-31, 30 d, monthly); Time tracking 3/12 (end 2027-08-31, 90 d, annual); Video conferencing tool 9/12 (end 2027-02-28, 30 d, monthly). ASSUMPTIONS: realisation share and person-days. Sources: out/fact_costs.csv, out/findings.csv, factors/factors.csv; Sample data ALTYCA, sprintd Basel 2026.

description: Use a small model with prompt caching for marketing text classification
change: Route the Classify task to a small model and enable caching for the repeated prompt part
risks_and_exceptions: T-1163: campaign-week peaks are expected use and stay. T-1212: the March script loop was a one-off and is excluded from the saving. Needs human decision: Marketing checks classification quality on a sample first.
assumptions_and_sources: CHF = F12 addressable; energy = ai-marketing energy x (1 - one-off loop share 28.7%) x saving share weighted by input and output tokens per row (3.77 bn in, 0.22 bn out; share low 0.800 / mid 0.787 / high 0.757). ASSUMPTIONS: realisation share and person-days. Sources: out/fact_costs.csv, out/findings.csv, factors/factors.csv; Sample data ALTYCA, sprintd Basel 2026.
